New artifact readers should prefer typed boundary helpers:
1. If an artifact family has a fromdict() class method, create a typed reader module (e.g., artifactreaders.py)
2. Use read<artifact>artifact() for paths where failures should propagate (strict boundary)
3. Use tryread<artifact>artifact() for paths where failures should be skipped (graceful fallback)
4. Log only safe metadata: filename, runid, error type - never raw content
5. Catch only expected shape errors: ValueError, TypeError, KeyError from fromdict()
